MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub fits my computer setup because it would connect peripherals such as my keyboard receiver and card reader, and the individual switches would be useful.",
    "The microSD card connects naturally to my Raspberry Pi purchases, although I would wait until I actually need more storage because I already bought a 32GB card."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming players and Echo devices do not help with the networking, organization, and maintenance tasks reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "The earbuds overlap with headphones I already own, while my headphone mount purchase points toward organizing existing equipment rather than replacing it.",
    "Owning a Kindle does not give me a reason to buy a Fire tablet; I have no current task that calls for another tablet."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "My previous Amazon device purchase seems to have been stretched into an interest in more Amazon devices, without a clear connection to what I am working on now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, Ethernet cables, backpack, headphone mount, and blower duster suggest practical needs around connecting, carrying, organizing, and maintaining my computer equipment.",
    "Accessories that complement equipment I already own are more useful to me now than additional devices with overlapping functions.",
    "A compatible item can still be something I would postpone: another microSD card fits my Raspberry Pi interests, but that does not mean I need one immediately."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer accessory needs but mostly interpreted my electronics purchases as a reason to suggest unrelated entertainment and smart home devices."
}
